explanation: The theorem says that the ring map ψ D g l, built from the library's own Plücker-embedding construction (Rep, S, τ, ψ, Pl), is surjective. Its proof uses the library's own lemmas (ψ_ratio, update_τ, eq_Pl_update) and `Module.Grassmannian.adjoin_eq_top_of_isOpenImmersion_of_opensRange_eq`, which is also from this project. Its content lies in those definitions. Mathlib has no Grassmannian functor, Plücker coordinates or `Module.Grassmannian`, so I found no declaration with the same statement. I did not run searches; this rests on my knowledge of Mathlib.
